# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains several hundred call snippets, but only a **modest subset are genuine sales/enquiry/negotiation calls**. The large majority are:
- Internal logistics/ops chatter (MTC/tag/test-certificate exchanges, driver coordination, loading/unloading disputes, e-way bill/invoice corrections)
- Personal/unrelated calls (the entire "Vishal" series is personal chit-chat in Hindi — cricket, bikes, family, unrelated to steel sales)
- Wrong numbers, voicemails, and one-word confirmations

The genuine sales calls that remain are mostly **short, transactional B2B conversations** between BSC's sales/counter staff (often addressed as "Varsha Madam") and dealers, fabricators, and site engineers calling for rates, stock availability, and order confirmation on **TMT rebar, MS plates/sheets, structural steel (ISMB/ISMC/angles/channels), flats, pipes/tubes, and coil-cutting services**. Negotiation is usually brief (₹500–₹2,000/ton asks), and many calls end in "I'll check and tell you" rather than a closed deal — reflecting a highly price-sensitive, commodity-trading sales motion. Given the thin volume of truly rich sales dialogues, this KB stays tightly grounded in what is actually said, without extrapolating into roofing or other product lines not mentioned.

## Products & brand ladder

- **TMT Rebar (steel rods)** — core product. Grades mentioned: **Fe 500 / 500D / 550D**. Brands: **Tata, Sale (SAIL), Vaisakh, Vizag (RINL)**.
  - "500 கிடைக்காது sir... 500 வந்து வெறும் R&L தான் sir produce பண்ணுவாங்க. அவங்க இப்ப 3 months-ஆ R&L production இல்ல." [500D grade is rare because RINL/Vizag has stopped producing it for 3 months; 550D is what's commonly available]
  - "sale TMT 500D தான் வருமா sir CRS-ல? ஆ CRS-ல 500D தான் sir வரும். 550 வராது." [In CRS (Sale), only 500D is manufactured, not 550D]
  - Sizes traded: 8mm to 32mm, with 12–32mm often quoted as one price slab.
- **MS Plates / Sheets (checkered & plain)** — sizes 4mm–20mm thickness, standard sheet 2500×1250 / 6300mm coil-cut lengths. Brands: NMDC (plate), Vaisakh, Sale.
- **Structural Steel** — ISMB, ISMC (I-channel), SHS/CHS pipes (bought-out, not manufactured by BSC — "SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir"), MS angles (L-angle, square/rectangle), MS flats.
- **CR (Cold Rolled) Coil / Sheet** — e.g., "CR coldron sheet... 0.6 mm thickness-ல... CR IS 513-ல match ஆகி கொடுக்கணும்" (customer wanting CR vendor, which BSC sources externally, not stocked).
- **Coil-cutting / slitting service** — BSC runs an internal cutting operation (Yuvraj Operator calls) converting coils into cut sheets per customer spec, including thickness tolerance checks (diagonal tests, "wrinkle"/line-mark quality checks before dispatch).
- **ISMB grades**: standard E250; E350 available at **+₹3,000** premium ("E350-ன்னா உங்களுக்கு அதோட ₹3000 extra வரும்").
- Weight/beam comparison selling: 300×140 vs 300×150 — same price category but different weight-per-meter (42 kg/m vs 46 kg/m) and flange thickness, with rate difference of ₹3,000, explicitly explained to customer as a trade-off.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- **TMT 12–32mm (single slab)**: "₹12-32 வச்சுக்கோங்க. ₹64" — described as including transport; previous rate was ₹67–68. "Chennai-ஆ இருந்தா இதுல இருந்து ₹1500 குறையும்."
- **Vizag TMT (per ton quotes)**: ₹62,000–65,000 range seen across different calls/dates; Sale quoted ~₹63.5–64 per unit in one comparison.
- **MS Plate/Sheet rates** (per kg, fluctuating): ₹59.5–₹67 depending on thickness and date — e.g. 8mm sheet ₹65.5 (20 ton order), 6mm plate ₹66–67, checkered/4-5mm plate ₹61.5–63.5 at different points.
- **Flat bar (negotiated deal)**: Asked ₹54; seller held firm near ₹53.5 as "least price" — "535 எடுத்துக்கங்க sir final... + GST loading transport extra."
- **ISMB option-selling**: 300/140 at ₹63 vs 300/150 at ₹60 — customer offered the lighter/cheaper option explicitly with weight math shown.
- **Terms consistently used**: "+ GST, loading, transport extra" (rates are basic/ex-work unless stated); "including transport" sometimes explicitly offered and then price falls ~₹1,500 for in-city delivery vs outstation.
- **Credit terms**: Mentioned once explicitly — "credit-ல close ஆயிடுச்சு... 1 month தான்" (1-month credit available, but rate is higher than advance-payment rate).
- **Payment-first policy**: "full payment இருந்தாதான் sir block பண்ண முடியும்" — material/rate can only be blocked against full advance, not partial.
- **Minimum quantity / new-customer policy**: "New customer-க்கு எல்லாம் சின்ன சின்ன quantity குடுக்குறது இல்ல sir" — small quantities not entertained for new/unknown customers.
- **Rate validity is short**: "இன்னைக்கு rate validity முடியுது Sir" — daily/short-validity pricing is standard practice, reinforced repeatedly across calls.

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Rate ரொம்ப ஜாஸ்தியா இருக்கு" (Price too high vs. competitor/last purchase)**
- Response pattern: acknowledge + explain market driver, don't cave immediately.
  > "material இல்லை sir... 1 item வந்து அதிகமா இருக்கு cost." / "rate increase ஆக போகுது... market அந்த மாதிரி இருக்கு sir."
- Explain supply-side logic when pushed: "Vizag இல்லைன்னா இவங்க 3 பேரும் (Tata/JSW/Sale) increase பண்ணிடுவாங்க... Vizag வந்த உடனே பாருங்க டக்குன்னு கம்மி பண்ணிட்டாங்க."

**2. "கம்மி பண்ணுங்க / loading charge வேண்டாம்"**
- Firm refusal when rate is genuinely final: "கம்மி பண்ண முடியாது sir. கரெக்டா இருக்கு rate." Occasionally small accommodation offered instead of price cut: "loading free பண்ணலாம்."
- When customer threatens to go elsewhere: hold the line politely, don't match blindly — "நீங்க கிடைச்சா வாங்கிருங்க. அவ்ளோ கம்மி நம்மளால கண்டிப்பா பண்ண முடியாது."

**3. Stock/thickness unavailable (e.g., 2.5mm not in stock)**
- Offer substitute immediately with transparency: "2.5-ல வேணும்னா local brand-ல கிடைக்கும்," or oversupply via nearest size "2.6 and 2.9 போட்டுருக்கேன்."
- Be upfront about brand-specific stock gaps: "Tata-ல கிடைக்காது... ஒரே ஒரு distributor கிட்ட தான் இருக்கு."

**4. Weight/quantity disputes on alternate sizes**
- When customer worries about weight difference costing them (fabricator won't pay for excess weight): acknowledge concretely — "weight difference வந்து எங்களுக்கு காசு கொடுக்க மாட்டாங்க," and let customer decide/escalate internally rather than overpromise.

**5. Payment/charges disputes (transport, handling charges "suddenly" changed)**
- De-escalate by offering a correction instrument rather than reversing the live invoice: "debit note raise பண்ணிடுறேன்... invoice cancel பண்ண முடியாது sir, e-way bill போட்டாச்சு."
- Acknowledge standard/old practice when customer cites history ("நீங்க எல்லா வாட்டியும் ₹200 தான் போட்டீருக்கீங்க") and commit going forward.
